ache.title: A character guide can be a quiet shopping list
ache.note: Gengchen gets a whole video guide here. Guides like this can make one character feel like the missing piece of your team, and that feeling is what makes a banner hard to skip. Learning a kit is fine. Wanting her because a video made her look essential is the part I keep an eye on.
ache.tip: Watch guides for characters you already own; for the rest, wait a day before you even open the banner.
lines: knowing a kit isn’t needing the kit
guides are fun. banners are not your friends
already have her? great. if not, breathe
